name: Video Hovers
author: Tean

sections.description:
Video hovers is an impressive showcase plugin, powered by html5 audio and video. You can easily add hover effects to your favorite music and videos. Support for Youtube and Vimeo videos included.

Key Features

  • Responsive Layout – Fully responsive and adaptable to any device.
  • Desktop & Mobile Optimized – Mobile and desktop browsers enhanced.
  • Lazy Scrolling/Loading – Loads videos only when visible, improving performance. Load only image poster before video is shown.
  • HTML Video Support – Add videos to gallery.
  • Youtube Support – Add Youtube videos to gallery.
  • Vimeo Support – Add Vimeo videos to gallery.
  • Audio Support – Add Audio Songs to gallery
  • Image Support – Add Images to gallery.
  • Customizable Settings – Choose between multiple available skins and change player colors and icons as desired.

Links

  • Homepage & Docs
  • Demo
  • User Manual

Support

  • For questions or support, open a ticket.

Advanced Features in PRO Version

Upgrade to Media Hovers PRO to unlock:

  • Unlimited videos: Add unlimited number of videos to the gallery
  • Premium skins: Gain access to all skins in gallery
  • Autoplay mode: Play videos on page start (in order, random, all)
  • Expand video to fullscreen: Expand video to fullscreen with one click for easy viewing
  • Video preview on seek: Show video preview when mouse moves over progress indicator
  • Display subtitles: Display subtitles over video
  • Show download button: Show download button with option to download custom video url or your choice
  • Show video in tooltip: Show video in tooltip (instead of inline)
  • Pagination: Paginate images per pages
  • Lightbox support: Display any custom data (video, audio, images) in lightbox
  • Custom playback rate: Set custom playback rate for video
  • Disable video on mobile: Disable video and show only images on mobile for performance
  • Search field: Show search field and filter videos
  • Duplicate gallery: One click duplicate gallery in admin for quick gallery creation
  • WordPress widgets: Include plugin into widgets area using WordPress widgets feature
  • Export / import gallery: Export gallery with all settings and import to another server
  • Domain switch: Easy domain switch of videos (any all data) to another url
  • WordPress smart script loading: Load plugin scripts only on selected pages in your WordPress site)

Quick Usage

  1. Create new gallery in Gallery Manager
  2. Add some images and videos to the gallery
  3. Get shortcode with your newly created gallery, example: [apmpp player_id=”1″]

Shortcode

Basic example:

[apmpp player_id=”1″]

External services

This plugin uses Vimeo Player to play Vimeo videos.
This service is provided by Vimeo https://vimeo.com/
Terms of use https://vimeo.com/legal
Privacy policy https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/articles/12426199699985-Overview-of-video-privacy-settings

This plugin uses Youtube Player to play Youtube videos.
This service is provided by Youtube https://youtube.com/
Terms of use https://www.youtube.com/static?template=terms
Privacy policy https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How do I create a gallery?

Navigate to Media Hovers > Gallery Manager > Add New Gallery, add your images there and customize settings.

How do I add gallery in a post or page?

Navigate to Media Hovers > Gallery Manager > Add New Gallery, customize settings. Get shortcode with your desired gallery you created.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes. Media Hovers is fully responsive and optimized for touch.

Can I use it with external media?

Yes, it supports many external media types (YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive, etc.).
